title: Act: Restyle IntroScreen as a centered dialog on a full-screen backdrop
summary: IntroScreen uses sf-fullscreen-bg, a parchment Frame dialog and a gold Button.
description: Rewrite the IntroScreen markup using the Frame and Button components, keeping the copy and onBegin.
acceptance_criteria: Begin is a gold Button inside a parchment dialog

steps.action: Import Frame and Button; make the section class 'intro-screen sf-fullscreen-bg'; wrap the four paragraphs and a Button variant gold labelled Begin in <Frame kind='parchment' className='sf-dialog text-center'>.
steps.code: <section className="intro-screen sf-fullscreen-bg"><Frame kind="parchment" className="sf-dialog text-center">...<Button variant="gold" onClick={onBegin}>Begin</Button></Frame></section>
steps.expected: Intro shows a centered parchment dialog over the room backdrop.
